test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 13 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the wife of B’

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the son of B’

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’

If P + Q – S + R × L ÷ M, then which of the following statements is correct?

options.text: Q is the sister of M.
L is the father of P
P is the brother of S.

solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/94f0af2bd93b93688d2c6092e652fb2d84f74342de195154154b4e73abc5a0da.png]

Statement given : P + Q – S + R × L ÷ M

So,

 
• P + Q → P is the brother of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe3327ec6621be4a7c0274e96152a3613207c0c1bd78e63c5d99620dad86bd08.png] 

 
• Q – S → Q is the wife of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f19d144194338b965eadef14bd257f1780354a157a6b1a983bdd36ffd19c93cc.png] 

 
• S + R → S is the brother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/32dc722c2c28283ef31d58f99072154f63989c1a31e3583be0420208c93e2ae8.png] 

 
• R × L → R is the son of L.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5adeafddb55154cbc94bd0cd3a5a4983f0e4ede154f1ee5ec7f15598c6d408b9.png] 

 
• L ÷ M → L is the husband of M. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8ee1be60507926cd33fbdf7a1c11f3fe993e0f49551af43b7f5ad5c499fd55d.png] 

 

Thus, according to the final family tree :

 
• Option - (1) : Q is the sister of M → This statement is incorrect as Q is daughter-in-law of M.
 
• Option - (2) : **P is S’s wife’s brother** → **This statement is correct.**
 
• Option - (3) : L is the father of P → This statement is incorrect as L is the father-in-law of P's sister Q.
 
• Option - (4) : P is the brother of S → This statement is incorrect as P is the brother-in-law of S.

Hence, "**Option - (2)**" is the correct answer.
